name: echolog
description: Record and review local EchoLog activity from Codex with guided Skills and typed MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Record and review local work with Skills and MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: Explicitly track work and review local EchoLog history from Codex. The Plugin launches el mcp on the same machine and keeps records in the user's EchoLog daemon and PostgreSQL.
defaultPrompt: Use $echolog:track-work to record my current task in EchoLog.
Use $echolog:track-work to add a blocker to my active EchoLog record.
Use $echolog:review-work to summarize today's EchoLog activity.
